description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeSkillAPITest' for testing the 'EmployeeSkillAPI' class in the OrangeHRM project. It includes multiple test methods for CRUD operations and validation rules related to employee skills API endpoints, utilizing mock objects and asserting responses.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'EmployeeSkillAPI' endpoints related to employee skills in the OrangeHRM system. It extends 'EndpointTestCase' and contains individual test methods for each API operation, including validation and CRUD operations.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillService
methods.description: Tests that the EmployeeSkillAPI can return an instance of EmployeeSkillService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee skill record via the API, mocking DAO and service layers, and asserting the normalized response and metadata.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for the GET one operation, ensuring correct validation configuration.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an employee skill record, mocking DAO and service layers, and asserting the result and metadata.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting employee skill records via the API, mocking DAO, and asserting the response and metadata.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks the validation rules for the delete operation.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employee skill record, mocking DAO and service layers, and asserting the output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the create operation.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving multiple employee skill records, mocking DAO, and verifying the normalized data and meta info.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for fetching all employee skills.
